race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
race.verdict: A strong race of its type, but PLACE DE LA NATION was the best of these over hurdles having won a Grade 1 at the Punchestown Festival on her final start and, likely to make a chaser, she holds obvious appeal. Echoing Silence may prove best of those with chasing experience, while the selection's stablemates Bambino Fever and Sainte Lucie also warrant respect on their chase bows. PLACE DE LA NATION (FR) ECHOING SILENCE (IRE) BAMBINO FEVER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Place De La Nation (11/4), Bambino Fever (7/2), Sainte Lucie (5/1), Carrigmoornaspruce (15/2), Echoing Silence (15/2), Mongibello (8/1), Blue Velvet (10/1), Changeyourstars (10/1), Carry On Heidi (25/1), Kelya (25/1), Miss Mini Bee (33/1), My Forever Annie (50/1), Miss Georgina (50/1)
